welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Daily Travel
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity
